title: Create a VPC using Cloud Shell
description: Create and then view a VPC with a subnet.

title: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
description: In this lab, you will explore how terraform can be used to create, manage, and destroy Google Cloud resources.

title: Creating Spanner Instances and Databases (Console)
description: In this lab, you create Spanner instances and databases using the Google Cloud Console.

title: Creating Spanner Instances and Databases (CLI and Terraform)
description: In this lab, you automate the creation of Spanner instances and databases using the Google Cloud SDK, the Command Line Interface (CLI), and Terraform.

title: Building Demand Forecasting with BigQuery ML
description: In this lab you will build a time series model to forcast demand of multiple products using BigQuery ML. This lab is based on a blog post and featured in an episode of Cloud OnAir.

title: Troubleshooting and Solving Data Join Pitfalls
description: In this lab, you explore the relationships between data tables and the pitfalls to avoid when joining them together.

title: Creating a Persistent Disk
description: In this hands-on lab, you will learn how to create a persistent disk and use it on a Google Compute Engine virtual machine. You will also learn about zones, regions, and different disk types. Watch the short preview Create a Persistent Disk, GCP Essentials.

title: Navigate Security Decisions with Gemini
description: In this lab, you will learn how to use Gemini, an AI-powered collaborator in Google Cloud, to navigate and understand different areas of security in your environment in Security Command Center.

title: Using Cloud SQL with Google Kubernetes Engine and Workload Identity
description: Connect a GKE cluster to Cloud SQL using Workload Identity and a sidecar proxy.

title: Deploying GKE Autopilot Clusters
description: Getting Started with Google Kubernetes Engine: Creating a GKE Autopilot Cluster via Google Cloud Console

title: Analyze Customer Reviews with Gemini Using SQL
description: Learn how to use BigQuery Machine Learning with remote models (Gemini) to analyze customer reviews using SQL.

title: BigLake: Qwik Start
description: In this lab, you will learn how to implement BigLake tables.

title: Connected Sheets: Qwik Start
description: Connected Sheets, you can analyze billions of rows and petabytes of data in Google Sheets without specialized knowledge of computer languages like SQL. In this hands-on-lab, you will learn how to connect a BigQuery dataset to Google Sheets and analyze your data.

title: Deploying GKE Autopilot Clusters from Cloud Shell
description: Use this template for lab guides created after April 8, 2020. Report issues to mafaulkner.

title: Develop Code with Gemini in BigQuery
description: In this lab you learn how to use Gemini code generation, explanation and suggestions in BigQuery.

title: Safeguarding with Vertex AI Gemini API
description: In this lab, you learn how to inspect the safety ratings returned from the Vertex AI Gemini API and how to set a safety threshold to filter responses.

title: Implement a Hub-and-Spoke Network Using Network Connectivity Center
description: In this lab, you create a hub and spoke topology using NCC. In this hands-on exercise, you'll design and implement a classic hub-and-spoke network topology. Your pre-configured environment includes three VPC networks—a central hub and two branches (spoke1 and spoke2).

title: Differential Privacy in Machine Learning with TensorFlow Privacy
description: In this lab, you learn how to use differential privacy in machine learning using TensorFlow Privacy.

title: Leverage the Autoscaler Tool for Cloud Spanner to Achieve Workload Elasticity
description: In this lab you'll deploy the open-source Autoscaler tool for Cloud Spanner, a companion tool to Cloud Spanner, in the per-project configuration where the autoscaler tools are located in the same project as the Cloud Spanner instance being autoscaled.

title: Build a basic Conversational Agent Flow
description: Build a basic conversational agent flow

title: Explore Data with Gemini in BigQuery
description: In this lab you will learn how to use Table Explorer and Data Insights with Gemini in BigQuery.

title: Conversational Agents: Parameter Manipulation
description: In this lab you will use regular expressions to do parameter validation (e.g., on a PNR Number) and reset parameters to null when the user starts a new flow of conversation.

title: Deploying Spanner Applications with Cloud Run Functions and Cloud Run
description: In this lab, you write applications that utilize Spanner databases, and deploy them to both Cloud Run Functions and Cloud Run. You also install, configure, and enable the Spanner emulator for use in development environments.

title: Creating Permanent Tables and Access-Controlled Views in BigQuery
description: This lab focuses on how to create new permanent reporting tables and logical reviews from an existing ecommerce dataset.

title: Datastream: PostgreSQL Replication to BigQuery
description: In this lab you will replicate data from a PostgreSQL database to BigQuery.

title: Use Cloud Run Functions to Load BigQuery
description: This hands-on lab shows you how to use Cloud Run functions to load data into BigQuery.

title: Analyze Customer Reviews with Gemini Using Python Notebooks
description: Learn how to use BigQuery Machine Learning with remote models (Gemini AI) to analyze customer reviews using Python Notebooks.

title: Explore and Create Reports with Looker Studio
description: In this lab, you learn how to connect Looker Studio to Google BigQuery data tables, create charts, and explore the relationships between dimensions and measures.

title: Use Serverless for Apache Spark to Load BigQuery
description: This hands-on lab shows you how to use Serverless for Apache Spark templates to load BigQuery.

title: Mitigate Bias with MinDiff in TensorFlow
description: This lab helps you learn how to mitigate bias using MinDiff technique by leveraging TensorFlow Model Remediation library.

title: Managing Environments with Conversational Agents
description: In this lab, you'll explore Managing Environments with Conversational Agents.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis using Bigquery and Workbench Instances
description: Exploratory Data Analysis using Bigquery and and Workbench Instances

title: Get Started with Security Command Center
description: In this lab, you explore the Security Command Center (SCC) interface, configurations, vulnerability findings, and analyze asset features.

title: Conversational Agents: Contextual Intents
description: In this lab you will learn how to use some advanced Conversational Agents features, like how to let a user ask your conversational agent to repeat what it said; let the user ask common questions from your FAQ in the middle of another conversation; ask context-sensitive questions, and add conversational branching and looping based on current values in the session parameters.

title: Introduction to Migration Center Servers Assessments
description: Learn how to assess a customer's existing environment, and import data collected from Azure/AWS infrastructure. Generate inventory, performance, network dependencies and financial reports such as TCO (total cost analysis) and DPR (detailed pricing) reports.

title: Reconciling Account Data with Cloud Spanner Change Streams
description: Learn how to perform financial account reconciliation tasks using Cloud Spanner, Dataflow, and BigQuery.

title: Managing Relationships with Foreign Keys and Interleaved Tables
description: In this lab, you create a database with multiple tables, and use both primary-foreign key contraints and interleaved tables to manage relationships.

title: Analyzing Movie Posters in BigQuery with Remote Models
description: In this lab, you learn how to use BigQuery Machine Learning for inference with remote models (Gemini AI models) to Analyze Movie Posters. BigQuery Machine Learning for inference lets you create and run machine learning (ML) models by using GoogleSQL queries.

title: End to End Baseline Audio Summarization
description: In this lab, you build a end to end Baseline Audio Summarisation pipeline.

title: Create and execute a SQL workflow in Dataform
description: This lab walks you through the process to create and execute a SQL workflow in Dataform to load data in BigQuery.

title: Streamlining Wildlife Image Classification in BigQuery with an Imported Model
description: In this lab, you learn how to streamline an image classification workflow in BigQuery using an imported model (PyTorch model created in ONNX format), and Google SQL queries.

title: Use Data Canvas to Visualize and Design Queries
description: In this lab you learn how to use Data Canvas to visualize and design queries.

title: Setting up Generative Knowledge Assist in the Agent Assist console
description: This lab provides a step-by-step approach to creating a Data Store, adding documents to the Data Store, creating a GKA infobot agent and attaching the Data Store to it, setting up an Agent Assist conversation profile, and linking it to the GKA Agent for Knowledge Assist using the Agent Assist console.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis using Bigquery and Colab Enterprise
description: Exploratory Data Analysis using Bigquery and Colab Enterprise

title: Build Apps with Gemini Code Assist
description: In this lab, you'll develop an app using assistance from Gemini within an IDE.

title: Vertex AI: Training and Serving a Custom Model
description: In this lab, you will use Vertex AI to train and serve a TensorFlow model using code in a custom container.

title: Continuous Delivery with Google Cloud Deploy
description: Create a delivery pipeline using Google Cloud Deploy, create a release for a basic application, and promote the application through a series of Google Kubernetes Engine targets

title: Getting Started with Vector Search and Embeddings
description: In this lab, you will use text embeddings and Vertex AI vector search to find similar documents based on their text content.

title: End to End Baseline Chat Summarization
description: In this lab, you build a end to end Baseline Chat Summarisation pipeline.

title: Get Started with Vertex AI Studio
description: In this lab, you learn to build generative AI prototypes with Vertex AI Studio and Gemini, mastering prompt design and multimodal analysis in the console, all without coding.
